id.description: Material id (1-64 characters), unique across all entities. Reference it from finishes and defaults.

kind.description: "paint" is a flat colour; "texture" adds a PBR texture set (needs textureUrl). Cannot change once defined.

color.description: Base colour as #rrggbb. For textures it is the fallback and tint colour.

roughness.description: Surface roughness from 0 (mirror) to 1 (matte). Defaults to 0.9.

textureUrl.description: Texture set as "lib:<slug>"; read materials://list for the available slugs. Required when kind is "texture".

textureScale.description: Size in metres of one texture tile. Optional.

material.description: The complete material. An existing id is fully replaced (omitted optional fields are cleared); kind cannot change.

index.description: Internal (used by undo): insert position. Do not send.

id.description: Id of the material to delete. Fails with precondition_failed while any wall, room or default uses it.

wallId.description: Id of the wall (walls[].id from get_scene_summary).

side.description: Which face of the wall. "left" is the left of someone walking from the wall start to its end on the plan (plan y grows down; see wallLeftNormal), "right" the other face, "both" both faces. With roomId, "both" means every face of this wall that the room adjoins.

materialId.description: Id of a defined material (materials[].id in get_scene_summary), or null to clear back to the default. To use a library texture first call material.define with textureUrl "lib:<slug>" (slugs: materials://list).

roomId.description: The room whose stretch of this wall side to paint (from list_rooms or describe_room). Strongly recommended: a wall side can be shared by several rooms (e.g. the alcove and the sejour) and without roomId the whole side is painted for all of them. Fails with precondition_failed if the room does not border that side. A room-scoped finish beats the whole-side finish and room.setWallFinish.

wallId.description: Id of the wall (walls[].id from get_scene_summary).

structural.description: true marks the wall structural (cannot be removed); false marks it removable; null clears the explicit mark so it is derived (exterior or at least 15 cm thick means structural). Only a user may set false on a wall that is structural by default.

roomId.description: Id of the room (from list_rooms or get_scene_summary).

materialId.description: Id of a defined material (materials[].id in get_scene_summary), or null to clear back to the default. To use a library texture first call material.define with textureUrl "lib:<slug>" (slugs: materials://list).

roomId.description: Id of the room (from list_rooms or get_scene_summary).

wall.description: Default wall material for faces without a finish. Omit to leave unchanged, null to clear.

floor.description: Default floor material. Omit to leave unchanged, null to clear.

ceiling.description: Default ceiling material. Omit to leave unchanged, null to clear.

northAngle.description: Clockwise angle in degrees from plan "up" (-y) to true north.

floorElevation.description: Height of the flat floor above street level, in metres.

address.description: Postal address (at most 300 characters); null clears it.

site.description: Fields to change; omitted fields stay as they are.

id.description: Optional light id; derived as "light-N" when omitted.

roomId.description: Room the light belongs to (from list_rooms). Optional.

position.description: Plan position [x, y] in metres; plan y grows down the page.

elevation.description: Height of the light source above the floor, in metres.

lumens.description: Luminous flux in lumens (a 60 W-equivalent bulb is about 800).

kelvin.description: Colour temperature in kelvin, 1000-12000 (2700 warm, 6500 daylight). Defaults to 2700.

on.description: Whether the light is switched on. Defaults to true.
